correctness.rationale: For independent uniform parents P_t in {1,...,t−1}, the ancestor event that t lies above the last vertex has probability 1/t for t<n, independently of P_t; the mixed indicator covariance depends on 1+H_(j−1)−H_(t−1). Summing t>j and discrete summation by parts gives Cov(X_(n,j),D_n)=1/j−sum_{t=j}^{n−1}t^(−2), including j=n−1. Direct subtraction gives 1/[j²(j+1)]>0, exact endpoint signs and at most one zero. The inverse-square Euler–Maclaurin tail gives j_+(n)/sqrt(n)→1/sqrt(2), profile n C→1−1/(2c²), and lattice correction 2sqrt(2)(beta−1/6). Independent exact enumeration of all parent arrays n=3..8 rechecked all labels; finite data is not an infinite proof.
